य: य The twenty-sixth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, or semivowel Y; in Bengal, it is usually pronounced J.

य mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who goes, a goer, a mover. m. (यः) 1 Air, wind. 2 Union, joining. 3 Fame, celebrity. 4 Barley. 5 Light, lustre. 6 Abandoning. 7 YAMA. f. (या) 1 Pudendum muliebre. 2 Going, proceeding. 3 A car, a carriage. 4 Prohibiting, restraining, checking. 5 Religious meditation. 6 Getting, obtaining. E. यज to worship, यम to check, &c., aff. ड.
यक: यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Which, (of many.) E. यट् which, and अकच् aff.
यकृत्: यकृत् m. (-कृत्) The liver. E. य union, (of the parts of the body,) कृ to make, aff. क्विप् and तुक्.
यकृदात्मिका: यकृदात्मिका f. (-का) A cockroach. E. यकृत् the liver, and आत्मन self, कन् aff., fem. form; like it in colour.
यकृद्वैरी: यकृद्वैरी f. (-री) A plant, a sort of tree, (Andersonia rohitaka.) E. यकृत् liver, and वैर inimical to.
यक्ष: यक्ष r. 10th cl. (यक्षयते) To worship, to honour or adore.

यक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A demigod, attendant especially on KUVERA, and employed in the care of his gardens and treasures. 2 A name of KUVERA. 3 The residence of INDRA. f. (-क्षी) The wife of KUVERA. E. यक्ष to worship, aff. घञ्.
यक्षकर्दम: यक्षकर्द्दम m. (-मः) Perfumed paste, used especially for anointing the body, and consisting of camphor, agallochum, musk and Kakkola; or the three first, with saffron and Sandal in equal proportions. E. यक्ष the demigod, and कर्द्दम clay; a perfume of which these beings are supposed to be fond.
यक्षकर्द्दम: यक्षकर्द्दम m. (-मः) Perfumed paste, used especially for anointing the body, and consisting of camphor, agallochum, musk and Kakkola; or the three first, with saffron and Sandal in equal proportions. E. यक्ष the demigod, and कर्द्दम clay; a perfume of which these beings are supposed to be fond.
यक्षधूप: यक्षधूप m. (-पः) 1 Resin in general. 2 Turpentine, the resinous exudation of the pine. E. यक्ष the demigod, and धूप perfume or incense, अण् aff.
यक्षरस: यक्षरस m. (-सः) Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. यक्ष the demigod, and रस taste, fondness.
यक्षराज्: यक्षराज् m. (-राट्) KUVERA, the deity of wealth, and lord of the demigods called Yakṣas. 2 A palæstrum, a place prepared for wrestling or boxing. E. यक्ष a Yakṣa, and राज् who rules or shines.
यक्षराज: यक्षराज m. (-जः) KUVERA: see the last. E. यक्ष the demigod, so called, and राज sovereign.
यक्षराट्पुरी: यक्षराट्पुरी f. (-री) Alakā the capital of KUVERA, supposed to be seated on mount Kailāsa. E. यक्ष्राज KUVERA, and पुरी city.
यक्षरात्रि: यक्षरात्रि f. (-त्रिः) The night of the day of full moon in the month Kārttika: see दीपाली. E. यक्ष the demigod, and रात्रि night; these spirits being supposed to be then abroad.
यक्षामलक: यक्षामलक m. (-कः) A tree, described as a sort of date. E. यक्ष a Yakṣa, and आमलक myrobalan.
यक्षावास: यक्षावास m. (-सः) The Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) E. यक्ष demigod, and आवास abode.
यक्षिणी: यक्षिणी f. (-णी) 1 The wife of KUVERA. 2 The wife of a Yakṣa. 3 A sort of female fiend, attached to the service of DURGĀ, and frequently maintaining, like a sylph or fairy, an intercourse with mortals. E. यक्षिन् a name of KUVERA, and ङीष् aff.
यक्षेन्द्र: यक्षेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of KUVERA. E. यक्ष, and इन्द्र lord.
यक्षेश: यक्षेश m. (-शः) KUVERA. E. यक्ष, and ईश lord; also यक्षेश्वर and the like.
यक्षोडुम्बरक: यक्षोडुम्बरक n. (-कं) The fruit of the Ficus religiosa.
यक्ष्मघ्नी: यक्ष्मघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) The raisin, or dried grape. E. यक्ष्म consumption, and घ्न destroyer.
यक्ष्मन्: यक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) Pulmonary consumption. E. यक्ष to worship, and मनिन् Uṇādi aff.; also with मन् aff. यक्ष्म m. (-क्ष्मः)
यक्ष्यमाण: यक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Proposing or wishing to worship. E. यक्ष to worship, desid. v., शानच् aff.
यङ्न्त: यङ्न्त m. (-न्तः) (In grammar,) The frequentative deponent verb. E. यङ्, and अन्त termination.
यङ्लुगन्त: यङ्लुगन्त m. (-न्तः) The frequentative active verb. E. यङ्, लुक् dropped, and अन्त termination.
यज: यज r. 1st cl. (यजति) 1 To worship a deity. 2 To associate with. 3 To present or endow.
यजत्: यजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Sacrificing, worshipping. E. यज to worship, शतृ aff.
यजत: यजत m. (-तः) The officiating priest at a sacrifice. E. यज to worship, अतच् aff.
यजत्र: यजत्र m. (-त्रः) A Brahman who has maintained his consecrated fire. E. यज to sacrifice, अत्रन् Uṇādi aff.
यजन: यजन n. (-नं) Offering sacrifices, performing worship. E. यज to worship, ल्युट् aff.
यजन्त: यजन्त m. (-न्तः) A sacrificer, a worshipper. E. यज to sacrifice, aff. झच्.
यजमान: यजमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Worshipping. m. (-नः) An employer of priests at a sacrifice, the person who institutes its performance, and pays the expence of it. E. यज to worship, शानच् aff. of the present participle, with मक् augment.
यजाक: यजाक m. (-कः) A donor, a benefactor, a liberal giver of presents, &c. E. यज to present, Uṇādi aff. आकन्.
यजि: यजि m. (-जिः) A sacrificer, one who institutes or performs a sacrifice. E. यज to sacrifice, aff. इन्.
यजुर्वेद: यजुर्वेद n. (-दं) The Yajur Veda: see the next. E. ययुस्, and वेद a Veda.
यजुस्: यजुस् n. (-जुः) The Yajur or Yajuṣ, one of the four Vedas; it is divided into two principal portions, the white and black, or Vājasaneyi and Taittirīya, the former of which is attributed to the saint YĀJÑAVALKYA, to whom it was revealed by the sun, in the form of a horse; and the latter to TITTIRI, to whom it was communicated by YĀSKA, the first pupil of its original author, the sage VAIŚAMPĀYANA: according to the Purāṇas, the Taittirīya portion was named from Tittiri a partridge; the disciples of VAIŚAMPĀYANA being changed into those birds, to pick up the texts of the Veda, as they were disgorged in a tangible shape by YĀJÑAVALKYA, at the command of VAIŚAMPĀYANA: both portions of this Veda are very full on the subject of religious rites, and the prayers peculiar to it, are chiefly in measured and poetical prose. E. यज to worship, Uṇādi aff. उसि.
यज्ञ: यज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A sacrifice, a ceremony in which oblations are presented. E. यज to worship, aff. नङ्.
यज्ञकर्मन्: यज्ञकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Any sacrificial act or ceremony. E. यज्ञ, and कर्म्मन् act.
यज्ञकर्म्मन्: यज्ञकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Any sacrificial act or ceremony. E. यज्ञ, and कर्म्मन् act.
यज्ञकृत्: यज्ञकृत् m. (-कृत्) A sacrificer, a worshipper, or priest conducting a sacrifice. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and कृत् who makes.
यज्ञद्रुह्: यज्ञद्रुह् m. (-ध्रुक्) A Rākṣasa, an imp. E. यज्ञ, and द्रुह् to wrong, क्विप् aff.
यज्ञपशु: यज्ञपशु m. (-शुः) 1 A horse. 2 Any animal offered in sacrifice. E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, and पशु an animal.
यज्ञपात्र: यज्ञपात्र n. (-त्रं) A sacrificial vessel. E. यज्ञ, and पात्र a vessel.
यज्ञपुरुष: यज्ञपुरुष m. (-षः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and पुरुष man or male.
यज्ञभाजन: यज्ञभाजन n. (-नं) A sacrificial vessel. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and भाजन vessel.
यज्ञभूमि: यज्ञभूमि f. (-मिः) Place prepared for a sacrifice, or where it is offered. E. यज्ञ, and भूमि land.
यज्ञवराह: यज्ञवराह m. (-हः) VIṢṆU in the boar incarnation. E. यज्ञ, and वराह the boar.
यज्ञवाट: यज्ञवाट m. (-टः) A place prepared and enclosed for a sacrifice. E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, and वाट inclosure.
यज्ञशिष्ट: यज्ञशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) What is left from a sacrifice or oblation. E. यज्ञ, and शिष्ट remainder.
यज्ञशेष: यज्ञशेष n. (-षः) The reliques of a sacrifice or oblation. E. यज्ञ, and शेष remainder.
यज्ञसार: यज्ञसार m. (-रः) The glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and सार essence.
यज्ञसिद्धि: यज्ञसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Performance of sacrifice. 2 Obtaining the objects of a sacrifice. E. यज्ञ, and सिद्धि accomplishment.
यज्ञसूत्र: यज्ञसूत्र n. (-त्रं) The characteristic thread, worn by the three principal classes of Hindus. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and सूत्र thread.
यज्ञस्थान: यज्ञस्थान n. (-नं) A place of sacrifice. E. यज्ञ, and स्थान place.
यज्ञाङ्ग: यज्ञाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The glomerous fig, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) 2 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 3 A part of any sacrificial ceremony. E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, and अङ्ग a member.
यज्ञान्त: यज्ञान्त m. (-न्तः) A supplementary sacrifice. E. यज्ञ the principal, and अन्त end, finish.
यज्ञारि: यज्ञारि m. (-रिः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A demon, a goblin. E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, and अरि enemy.
यज्ञिक: यज्ञिक m. (-कः) The Pālaś tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. यज्ञ sacrifice, ठक् aff.
यज्ञिय: यज्ञिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Proper for or suitable to a sacrifice. m. (-यः) The third Yug or age. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and घ aff.
यज्ञियदेश: यज्ञियदेश f. (-शः) The country of the Hindus; those districts in which the ritual and institutes of the Hindu system are enforced; properly the country in which the black deer or antelope is native. E. यज्ञिय sacrificial, and देश a country.
यज्ञियशाला: यज्ञियशाला f. (-ला) A temple, a shrine, a place of sacrifice. E. यज्ञिय to be sacrificed, (where,) and शाला hall.
यज्ञोडुम्बर: यज्ञोडुम्बर m. (-रः) The glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and उडुम्बर the same.
यज्ञोपवीत: यज्ञोपवीत n. (-तं) The sacrificial cord, originally worn by the three principal casts of Hindus: at present from the loss of the pure Kṣatriya and Vaiśya casts in Bengal, confined to the Brahmanical order. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and उपवीत thread.
यज्ञोपवीतिन्: यज्ञोपवीतिन् m. (-ती) A Brahman, &c. invested with the sacred thread. E. यज्ञोपवीत, and इनि aff.
यज्यु: यज्यु m. (-ज्युः) A Brahman, Conversant with the Yajur Veda. E. यज to worship, Uṇādi aff. युच्.
यज्वन्: यज्वन् m. (-ज्वा) A sacrificer in due form, or agreeably to the ritual of the Vedas. E. यज to worship, वनिप् aff.
यज्वनांपति: यज्वनांपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. यज्वन् a sacrificer in the sixth case plural, and पति master.
यत: यत(ई)यती r. 1st cl. (यतते) To resolve or determine in consequence of a wish or desire, to apply or endeavour 1 strenuously, to energize, to persevere. r. 10th cl. (यातयति) 1 To distress or afflict. 2 To beat. 3 To order. 4 To collect, to assemble. 5 To work, to make or manufacture. 6 To prevent, to remove. 7 To return, to give back, to requite. 8 To barter or exchange. 9 To purify. With निर् or नि prefixed, To chastise, to punish, to inflict pain.
यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Governed, controlled. 2 Limited, restrained. E. यम to check, क्त aff.
यत्: यत् ind. Because, as, since, wherefore, correlative of तत् thence, therefore, &c. E. यम to check, to restrain, क्विप् and तुक् aff.
यतचित्त: यतचित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Resigned, subdued, one of well-governed thoughts or feelings. E. यत, and चित्त the mind.
यतचित्तात्मन्: यतचित्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Having power over the soul and spirit, of subdued mind. E. यतचित्त, and आत्मन् self.
यतत्: यतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Striving, making effort, E. यत to make effort, शतृ aff.
यतन: यतन n. (-नं) Making effort or exertion. E. यत to make effort, ल्युट् aff.
यतनीय: यतनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be exerted or persevered, to be made as an effort. E. यत to make effort अनीयर्, aff.
यतम: यतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Which, (of many.) E. यद् which, डतमच् aff.
यतमान: यतमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Making effort, striving, struggling, persevering. E. यत to strive, शानच् aff.
यतमैथुन: यतमैथुन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Disinclined to sexual intercourse, abstaining from it. E. यत, and मैथुन coition.
यतर: यतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Which, (of two,) whether. E. यट् which, डतरच् aff.
यतव्रत: यतव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Firm to an engagement or vow. E. यत, and व्रत a vow.
यतस्: यतस् ind. Because, as since, whence: see यत्. E. यद् which, what, and तसि substituted for the termination of the 5th case.
यतात्मन्: यतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Of subdued or well-governed spirit. E. यत, and आत्मन् self.
यतात्मवत्: यतात्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Self-subdued, having the mind and all its powers in subjection. E. यतात्म, and मतुप् aff.
यताहार: यताहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Temperate, abstemious. E. यत, and आहार food.
यति: यति m. (-तिः) 1 A sage, whose passions are completely under subjection. 2 A religious mendicant, especially one of the Jaina sect. 3 Stopping, ceasing, rest, term. 4 Restraining, controlling, checking. f. (-तीः) 1 A pause in poetry or metre, a stop, a rest. 2 Union, joining. 3 Passion, sentiment. 4 A widow. E. यत to endeavour, &c., aff. इन्, or यम् to restrain, aff. क्तिन्.
यतिन्: यतिन् m. (-ती) A sage with subdued passions. f. (-नी) A widow. E. यत restraining, from यम with क्त aff., and इनि added.
यतिपात्र: यतिपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel for collecting alms, made of wood, or a hollow bambu, an earthen bowl, or a gourd. E. यति, and पात्र a vessel.
यतिमैथुन: यतिमैथुन n. (-नं) The copulation or cohabitation of holy personages. E. यति as above, and मैथुन coition.
यतुका: यतुका f. (-का) A plant, Cakāvat commonly.
यतेन्द्रिय: यतेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Chaste, pure, of subdued passions. E. यत, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
यत्कर: यत्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Doing what. E. यत्, and कृ to do, अच् aff.
यत्त: यत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Striven, resolved, exerted. E. यत to resolve, क्त aff.
यत्न: यत्न m. (-त्नः) Effort, exertion, perseverance, energy. E. यत to endeavour strenuously or continuously, aff. नङ्.
यत्नतस्: यत्नतस् ind. Vigorously, strenuously. E. यत्न, and तसि aff.
यत्नवत्: यत्नवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Persevering, diligent, making effort or exertion. E. यत्न effort, मतुप् aff.
यत्य: यत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) To be exerted or made as an effort. E. यत to exert, यत् aff.
यत्र: यत्र ind. Where, in what place. E. यद what, and त्रल् aff.
यत्र(इ,)यत्रि r. 1st and 10th cls. (यन्त्रति यन्त्रयति) To confine, to restrain, to subdue or regulate: the root may also be written यन्त्र.
यथा: यथा ind. As, according to; correlative to तथा so: it is also commonly used in composition to form adverbs: यथाकालं seasonably, यथाक्रमं regularly, यथान्यायं fitly, suitably, यथाशास्त्रं according to scripture, &c. E. यद् what, थाल् aff.
यथांशतस्: यथांशतस् ind. Proportionably, in due proportion. E. यथा as, according to, अंश part, तसि aff.
यथाकथा: यथाकथा ind. As much as, tantum quantum: it is especially used as a term of disrespect. E. यथा as, and कथा how.
यथाकथाच: यथाकथाच ind. Rarely, unfrequently, seldomer than proper. E. यथा as much, and कथा how much, with च the particle, and.
यथाकर्तव्य: यथाकर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What is right or proper to be done. E. यथा, कर्त्तव्य to be done.
यथाकर्त्तव्य: यथाकर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What is right or proper to be done. E. यथा, कर्त्तव्य to be done.
यथाकल्प: यथाकल्प adv. (-ल्पं) As designed. E. यथा, and कल्प making.
यथाकाम: यथाकाम adv. (-मं) At pleasure, as you please. E. यथा, and काम desire.
यथाकामिन्: यथाकामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Wilful, independant, uncontrolled, following one's own inclinations. E. यथा as, according to, काम desire, इनि aff.
यथाक्रम: यथाक्रम adv. n. (-मं) In order, orderly, successively, methodically. E. यथा agreeably to, क्रम order.
यथागत: यथागत adv. n. (-तं) Applied to a person's being sent away or returning as he came. E. यथा, and गत gone.
यथाजात: यथाजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Foolish, stupid, a fool, a natural. 2 Barbarous, outcast. E. यथा as, and जात born, as simple as at birth.
यथातथ: यथातथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Right, true. ind. or adv. n. (-थं) Properly, suitably. noun. (-थं) Narrative of events, history. E. यथा as, and तथा so, with the termination of the neuter gender.
यथातथा: यथातथा adv. In any way, any how. E. यथा and तथा, &c.
यथापूर्व: यथापूर्व्व n. adv. (-र्व्वं) 1 In order or succession. 2 Formerly, precedingly, in prior time or place. E. यथा as, and पूर्व्व formerly, before.
यथापूर्व्व: यथापूर्व्व n. adv. (-र्व्वं) 1 In order or succession. 2 Formerly, precedingly, in prior time or place. E. यथा as, and पूर्व्व formerly, before.
यथाभिमतम्: यथाभिमतम् ind. According to one's wish or purpose. E. यथा, and अभिमत purposed.
यथामुखीन: यथामुखीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Like, resembling, shewing similarly or reflecting. E. यथा as, मुख the countenance, and ख aff.
यथायथम्: यथायथम् ind. As, thereto appertaining. E. यथा repeated, with the termination of the neuter gender.
यथार्थ: यथार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Right, proper. 2 According to the sense. adv. or ind. n. (-र्थं) Properly, suitably. E. यथा as, अर्थ property.
यथार्थता: यथार्थता f. (-ता) Rectitude, propriety, fitness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, यथार्थत्वं.
यथार्ह: यथार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Proper, suitable, appropriate. n. adv. or ind. (-र्हं) Properly, suitably. E. यथा as, अर्हम् properly.
यथार्हतस्: यथार्हतस् adv. Properly, fitly. E. यथार्ह, and तसि aff.
यथार्हवर्ण: यथार्हवर्ण m. (-र्णः) A spy, a secret emissary. E. यथार्ह properly, suitably, वर्ण form, colour.
यथावकाश: यथावकाश adv. n. or ind. (-शं) According to opportunity. E. यथा, and अवकाश season.
यथावत्: यथावत् ind. 1 Truly, exactly, as it was, according to law or usage. 2 Accordingly, conformably. E. यथा, and वति aff.
यथावसर: यथावसर adv. n. or ind. (-रं) According to opportunity. E. यथा, and अवसर opportunity.
यथाविधि: यथाविधि ind. or n. adv. According to rule. E. यथा, and विधि precept.
यथावृत्त: यथावृत्त adv. (-त्तं) Circumstantially, relating a thing as it happened. E. यथा, and वृत्त being.
यथाशक्ति: यथाशक्ति adv. n. (-क्ति) Extent of capability, as much as possible. E. यथा as much as, and शक्ति power.
यथाशास्त्र: यथाशास्त्र adv. n. (-स्त्रं) According to the Śāstras, agreeably to scripture. E. यथा agreeably to, शास्त्र the Śāstras.
यथासुख: यथासुख adv. (-खं) Happily. E. यथा, and सुख pleasure.
यथास्थित: यथास्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Right, proper, fit, true. n. (-तं) Circumstantially, or all that happened or existed. E. यथा as, and स्थित fixed, established.
यथास्वम्: यथास्वम् ind. As, according, or appertaining to, properly, peculiarly. E. यथा as, and स्व own, peculiar.
यथेप्सित: यथेप्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired. adv. n. or ind. (-तं) 1 Willingly, voluntarily. 2 Wilfully, independantly. E. यथा as, इप्सित (participle past, desiderative form of आप to obtain), desired, wished.
यथेष्ट: यथेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Wished, desired. adv. n. or ind. (-ष्टं) According to will or inclination.
यथेष्टचारिन्: यथेष्टचारिन् m. (-री) A bird. E. यथा as, इष्ट wished, and चारिन् who goes.
यथोचित: यथोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Right, proper. adv. n. or ind. (-तं) Properly, suitably. E. यथा, and उचित proper.
यथोदित: यथोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) As said or explained. E. यथा as, उदित said.
यद्: यद् mfn. relative pronoun (-यः-या-यत्) Who, which, what. E. यज to worship, Uṇādi aff. अदि, with the power of डित्.
यदा: यदा ind. When, at what time. E. यट् what, दाच् aff., and the final rejected.
यदि: यदि ind. If; particle of suspicion or doubt. E. यत to make effort, इञ् aff., and the radical final changed to द.
यदु: यदु m. (-टुः) 1 The name of a king, the ancestor of KṚṢṆA, and the eldest son of YAYĀTI, the fifth monarch of the lunar dynasty. 2 A country on the west of the Jumna river about Mathurā and Vṛndāvana, over which YADU ruled, and named after him: according to some authorities, however, the kingdom of YADU, is the Dekshin or Peninsula of India. m. plu. (-वाः) 1 The Yādavas, the people of YADU. 2 Descendants of king YADU: more usually however यादवा.
यदुनाथ: यदुनाथ m. (-थः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. यटु the son of YAYĀTI, but here put for his race, and नाथ lord, chief.
यदृच्छा: यदृच्छा f. (-च्छा) 1 Wilfulness, independence, following one's own fancies. 2 (In grammar,) A noun which is neither a generic nor specific term, nor noun of agency; one either not derived from authority, or not possessing meaning. E. यत् what, which, ऋच्छ to go, aff. अ and टाप्.
यदृच्छाभिज्ञ: यदृच्छाभिज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A voluntary or self-offered witness. E. यदृच्छा, and अभिज्ञ who knows.
यद्यपि: यद्यपि adv. Although. E. यदि, and अपि certainly.
यद्वत्: यद्वत् ind. As, in what manner, correlative to तद्वत्. E. यट्, and वति aff.
यन्तृ: यन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) A check, a restraint, any person or thing that restrains, &c. m. (-न्ता) 1 A charioteer. 2 An elephantdriver. E. यम to restrain, aff. तृच्.
यन्त्र: यन्त्र r. 1st and 10th cls. (यन्त्रति यन्त्रयति) To restrain: see यत्रि.

यन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) 1 A machine in general, any implement or apparatus. 2 A diagram of a mystical nature, or astrological character. 3 A sort of vessel. 4 Restraining, checking, controlling. E. यम to check, Uṇādi aff. त्र.
यन्त्रक: यन्त्रक m. (-कः) A lathe. f. (-का) A wife's younger sister. E. यन्त्र a machine or restraining, &c., and कन् added.
यन्त्रगृह: यन्त्रगृह n. (-हः) 1 An oil mill. 2 A manufactory. E. यन्त्र any machine, the apparatus used for grinding substances yielding oil, and गृह a house.
यन्त्रगोल: यन्त्रगोल m. (-लः) Common pea. E. यन्त्र a machine, and गोल. round.
यन्त्रण: यन्त्रण n. (-णं) 1 Pain, anguish, affliction. 2 Binding, confining. 3 Checking, controlling, especially the passions. E. यत्रि to restrain, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
यन्त्रपेषणी: यन्त्रपेषणी f. (-णी) A handmill. E. यन्त्र a machine, and पेषणी a stone for grinding on.
यन्त्रित: यन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bound, tied, chained, fettered. 2 Checked, restrained. E. यन्त्र restraining, and इतच् aff.
यन्त्रितकथ: यन्त्रितकथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Restrained in speech, constrained to be silent. E. यन्त्रित, and कथा speech.
यम: यम r. 1st cl. (औ उ) औयमु (यच्छति) To stop, to cease, to refrain. With नि prefixed, 1 To remove, to dispel. 2 To observe as a vow or religious rite. 3 To regulate, to restrain. With उत्, 1 To rise, to mount on. 2 To make effort or exertion. 3 To lift up, to raise. With वि and आङ्, To exercise. With सम् and नि, To restrain. In some senses it takes the deponent form, as with आङ्, prefix, (आयच्छते) To put forth, to use or employ any part of one's own body, as the hand, &c. (आयच्छति) 1 To seize. 2 To go to, to proceed to. With सम्, (संयच्छते) To heap together any thing that is one's own. (संयच्छति) To associate with. With उप, (उपयच्छते) 1 To marry. 2 To agree or accede to. 3 To master by learning. r. 10th cl. (यमयति यामयति) 1 To feed, to give food to. 2 To restrain.

यम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Twin, fellow, one of a pair or brace. m. (-मः) 1 Restraining, controlling. 2 Forbearance, refraining. 3 Cessation, stop, conclusion, finish. 4 Religious restraint or obligation. 5 Penance, purification, the performance of those acts which remove impurity of any kind. 6 Any of the five acts or virtues, which constitute pure characters, as refraining from violence or injury, patience, sincerity, obedience to a spiritual teacher, and the observance of all purificatory ceremonies. 7 A festival. 8 A crow. 9 A name of the planet SATURN. 10 YAMA, the deity of Naraka or hell, where his capital is placed, in which he sits in judgment on the dead, and distributes rewards and punishments, sending the good to Svarga, and the wicked to the division of Naraka or Tartarus appropriated to their crimes: he corresponds with the Grecian god PLUTO, and the judge of hell MINOS, and in Hindu mythology is often identified with Death and Time: he is the son of SŪRYA or the sun, and brother of the personified YAMUNĀ or Jumna river. n. (-मं) A brace, a couple, a pair. f. (-मी) The Yamunā river. E. यम to restrain, &c., aff. अच् or अप्.
यमक: यमक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Twin, fellow, one of a pair or twins. m. (-कः) A religious obligation or observance. n. (-कं) 1 A species of alliteration, the repetition of similar words or syllables either in a similar or a dissimilar sense in various parts of a stanza, beginning, middle, or end of each hemistich, or pervading the whole verse: ten varieties are enumerated. 2 A couple of like articles; (in medicine,) serum and marrow: (in diet,) oil and ghee, &c. E. कन् added to the preceding.
यमकालिन्दी: यमकालिन्दी f. (-न्दी) SAṂJÑĀ, the wife of the sun. E. यम YAMA, and कालिन्दी the Yamunā river; their mother.
यमकीट: यमकीट m. (-टः) An earthworm. E. यम YAMA, and कीट a worm.
यमदग्नि: यमदग्नि m. (-ग्निः) 1 The saint JAMADAGNI, the father of the first RĀMA. 2 PARAŚURĀMA, son of the preceding. E. see जमदाग्नि, य being substituted for ज.
यमदूत: यमदूत m. (-तः) An infernal spirit, the messenger or minister of YAMA, employed to bring the souls of the dead to YAMA'S judgment seat, and thence conduct them to their final destination. E. यम YAMA, and टूत a messenger.
यमदूतक: यमदूतक m. (-कः) 1 A crow. 2 A messenger or minister of YAMA. f. (-का) The tamarisk tree. E. कन् pleonasm or aff. of comparison, added to the last.
यमदेवता: यमदेवता nf. (-तं-ता) The lunar asterism Bharaṇī. E. यम YAMA, देवता deity, the deity or regent of this constellation.
यमन: यमन n. (-नं) 1 Binding, confining. 2 Term, cessation, rest. 3 Controlling, restraining. m. (-नः) A name of YAMA. E. यम to restrain, aff. ल्युट्.
यमनिका: यमनिका f. (-का) A wall or screen of cloth surrounding a tent. E. यम stop or check, aff. ल्युट्, कन् added, fem. form.
यमप्रिय: यमप्रिय m. (-यः) Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) E. यम YAMA, and प्रिय beloved.
यमभगिनी: यमभगिनी f. (-नी) The YAMUNĀ or Jumnā river. E. यम YAMA, and भगिनी sister.
यमरथ: यमरथ m. (-थः) A buffalo. E. यम YAMA, and रथ a car.
यमराज्: यमराज् m. (-राट्) YAMA, the Indian PLUTO. E. यम YAMA, and राज् ruler; also with a final vowel यमराज m. (-जः.)
यमल: यमल n. (-लं) A pair, a brace, a couple. f. (-ली) A sort of dress, a body and petticoat. (-ला) Violent hiccough. E. यम to refrain, to cease, aff. कलच्.
यमलार्जुनहन्: यमलार्जुनहन् m. (-हा) KṚṢṆA. E. यमलार्जुन a tree so named in the forest of Vṛndāvana, and हन् destroyer.
यमवाहन: यमवाहन m. (-नः) A buffalo. E. यम YAMA, and वाहन vehicle.
यमव्रत: यमव्रत n. (-तं) One of the duties of royalty, punishing offences without regard to persons, or without partiality or prejudice. E. यम the judge of Tartarus, and व्रत observance.
यमसभ: यमसभ n. (-भं) The court or tribunal of Yama. E. यम, and सभा assembly.
यमसभनीय: यमसभनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging to the court of Yama. E. यमसभ, and छ aff.
यमसात्कृत: यमसात्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made over to, devoted to, or sent to YAMA. E. यम with साति aff., and कृत made.
यमस्वसृ: यमस्वसृ f. (-सा) 1 The YAMUNĀ or Jumnā river. 2 A name of DURGĀ. E. यम YAMA, and स्वसृ the sister.
यमानी: यमानी f. (-नी) A sort of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen, Rox.) E. यम YAMA, आङ् before नी to obtain, aff. अण् and ङीष्; with ण्वुल् aff. यमानिका; it is more usually read यवानी, and यवानिका.
यमान्तक: यमान्तक m. (-कः) A name of ŚIVA. E. यम YAMA, and अन्तक destroyer.
यमिन्: यमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Who or what restrains, checks, &c. m. (-मी) A sage, who has subdued his senses. E. यम restraint, and इनि aff.
यमुना: यमुना f. (-ना) The YAMUNĀ or Jumnā river, which rises on the south side of the Himāla range, at a short distance to the north-west of the source of the Ganges, and which after a course of about 378 miles falls into that river immediately below Allahabad; in mythology, the personified river is considered as the daughter of SŪRYA, and sister of YAMA. E. यम to stop, (at the Ganges,) and उनन् Uṇādi aff.
यमुनाजनक: यमुनाजनक m. (-कः) SŪRYA, or the sun. E. यमुना the river, and जनक parent.
यमुनाभिद्: यमुनाभिद् m. (-भिद् or भित्) BALADEVA, the brother of KṚṢṆA. E. यमुना the Yamunā, and भिद् divider; having divided the river into two parts with his ploughshare.
यमुनाभ्रातृ: यमुनाभ्रातृ m. (-ता) A name of YAMA. E. यमुना the Yamunā, and भ्रातृ brother.
यमेरुका: यमेरुका f. (-का) A Gong, a metal plate, or a large drum used to strike the hours or watches.
ययाति: ययाति m. (-तिः) A monarch of India, the fifth of the lunar race.
ययी: ययी m. (-यी) 1 A road. 2 A name of ŚIVA. E. या to go, Uṇādi aff. ई, and the root repeated, form irr.
ययु: ययु m. (-युः) 1 A horse fit for the Aśvamedha sacrifice. 2 Any horse. E. या to go, Uṇādi aff. उ, the root reiterated, and form irr.
यर्हि: यर्हि adv. Wherefore, when. E. यट्, and र्हिल् aff.
यव: यव m. (-वः) 1 Barley, (Hordeum hexastichon.) 2 The measure of a barley corn, considered as equal to six mustard seeds. 3 A natural line across the thumb at the second joint, when it may be compared to a grain of barley, and supposed to indicate good fortune. 4 Speed, velocity. 5 A double convex lens. E. यु to join or mix, aff. अप्.
यवक: यवक m. (-कः) Barley. E. यव barley, and कन् pleonasm.
यवक्य: यवक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) Fit for or producing barley, a field, &c. E. यवक barley, यत् aff.
यवक्षार: यवक्षार m. (-रः) Saltpetre, nitre, nitrate of potash. E. यव barley, and क्षार ashes or salt; being prepared, according to some of the commentators, accurately enough, from burnt barley, the potash being thus procured; according to others however it is so termed, from the crystals being supposed to resemble the spike of the plant.
यवक्षोद: यवक्षोद m. (-दः) Barley meal. E. यव barley, and क्षोद meal or powder.
यवगण्ड: यवगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of eruption on the face. E. यव for युव youth, and गण्ड affecting the cheek.
यवज: यवज m. (-जः) Nitre. E. यव barley, and ज born: see यवक्षार.
यवन: यवन m. (-नः) 1 A country; probably Bactria, or it may be extended from that colony to Ionia, (to which word it bears some resemblance,) or still further to Greece: by late Hindu writers, it is most commonly applied to Arabia. 2 A Yavana, apparently originally a Greek, but since applied to both the Mohammedan and European invaders of India, and often used as a general term for any foreign or barbarous race. 3 Speed, velocity. 4 A swift horse. f. (-नी) The wife of a Yavana. E. यु to mix, aff. युच्, or जु to be swift, and the consonant changed to its analogous semivowel: or योनि the womb, (of the cow of VASIṢṬHA,) and अण् aff.; being born for the purpose of opposing the armies of VIŚVĀMITRA.
यवनप्रिय: यवनप्रिय n. (-यं) Black pepper. E. यवन a Yavana, and प्रिय fond of.
यवनाचार्य: यवनाचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) An astronomical writer, frequently quoted by Varāhamihira, and other ancient Hindu astronomers: perhaps PTOLEMY, or the Greek astronomers collectively. E. यवन a Yāvana, and आचार्य्य a holy teacher.
यवनाचार्य्य: यवनाचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) An astronomical writer, frequently quoted by Varāhamihira, and other ancient Hindu astronomers: perhaps PTOLEMY, or the Greek astronomers collectively. E. यवन a Yāvana, and आचार्य्य a holy teacher.
यवनारि: यवनारि m. (-रिः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. यवन a Yavana, and अरि enemy.
यवनाल: यवनाल m. (-लः) 1 A sort of grass, very generally cultivated, and the grain extensively eaten, (Andropogon or Holcus bicolor.) 2 Barley straw. E. यत्र barley, and नाल culm or stalk; also यावनाल.
यवनालज: यवनालज m. (-जः) Nitre. E. यवनाल barley straw, and ज produced: see यवक्षार.
यवनिका: यवनिका f. (-का) An outer tent, a screen of cloth surrounding a tent or tents. E. see जवनिका, ज being changed to य.
यवनेष्ट: यवनेष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Lead. m. (-ष्टः) 1 Garlick. 2 A sort of onion. 2 The Nimb tree. E. यवन a Yavana, a barbarian, and इष्ट wished, desired.
यवप्रख्या: यवप्रख्या f. (-ख्या) A small hard indolent tumor like a barley corn. E. यव, and प्रख्या appellation.
यवफल: यवफल m. (-लः) 1 A bambu. 2 Indian spikenard. 3 A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica) 4 An onion. E. यव barley, &c., and फल fruit.
यवमध्य: यवमध्य n. (-ध्यं) A form of penance, diminishing the food daily during the dark fortnight, fasting on the new moon, and gradually augmenting the food till the full moon. f. (-ध्या) A form of metre, a triplet, the divisions of which are of unequal length, the middle line having one syllable more than the first or last. E. यव barley, मध्य centrical.
यवमय: यवमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of or from barley. E. यव barley, and मयट् aff.
यवलास: यवलास m. (-सः) Nitre, saltpetre. E. यव barley, and लस to like, aff. घञ्.
यवशूक: यवशूक m. (-कः) Nitre, saltpetre. E. यव barley, and शूक the beard of corn.
यवस: यवस m. (-सः) Meadow or pasture grass. E. यु to mix, असच् aff.
यवसुर: यवसुर n. (-रं) Spirituous or fermented liquor distilled from barley, beer. E. यव barley, सुरा wine, ष aff., in the neuter gender; also यवसुरा the second member being unchanged.
यवागू: यवागू f. (-गूः) Sour gruel, prepared by the spontaneous fermentation of water in which rice has been boiled. E. यु to mix, आगूच् Uṇādi aff.
यवाग्रज: यवाग्रज m. (-जः) Saltpetre. E. यत्र barley, अग्र the top or ear, and ज born.
यवान: यवान mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Swift, fleet. f. (-नी) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen.) E. यव speed, नी to possess, prefix आङ्, and aff. ड; also with कन् added, fem. form यवानिका.
यवास: यवास m. (-सः) A flower, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. यु to mix, Uṇādi aff. आस; also with कन् added, यवासक.
यविष्ठ: यविष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Youngest, very young. m. (-ष्ठ) A younger brother. E. युवन् young, इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative; also with कन् added, यविष्ठक.
यविष्ठवत्: यविष्ठवत् adv. Like a youth. E. यविष्ठ, and वति aff.
यवीयस्: यवीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Youngest, very young. m. (-यः) A younger brother. E. युवन् young, इयसुन् aff.
यव्य: यव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Fit for barley, sown with barley, &c. m. (-व्यः) A month. E. यव barley, and यत् aff.
यशःपटह: यशःपटह m. (-हः) A drum, a double drum. E. यशस् fame, and पटह a drum.
यशःशेष: यशःशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Dead, deceased. m. (-षः) Death, dying. E. यशस् fame, and शेष end.
यशस्: यशस् n. (-शः) 1 Glory, fame, celebrity, reputation. 2 Splendour, lustre. 3 Praise, eulogium. E. अश to pervade, to spread abroad, aff. असुन, and युट् augment, substituted for the initial.
यशस्कर: यशस्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Rendering famous, conferring celebrity. E. यशस् fame, कृ to make, aff. टच्.
यशस्काम: यशस्काम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Ambitious, desirous of fame or glory. E. यशस्, and काम desire.
यशस्काम्यत्: यशस्काम्यत् mfn. (-म्यन्-म्यती-म्यत) Desiring fame or glory. E. यशस्, and काम्यत् desiring.
यशस्वत्: यशस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) Famous, celebrated. E. यशस् fame, मतुप् poss. aff.
यशस्विन्: यशस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) Famed, renowned, celebrated. f. (-स्विनी) Wild cotton. E. यशस् fame, and विनि aff.
यशस्य: यशस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Conferring fame. E. यशस्, and यत् aff.
यशोघ्न: यशोघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Destroying fame, rendering infamous. E. यशस्, and घ्न what destroys.
यष्टि: यष्टि mf. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टी) 1 A staff, a stick. 2 A staff armed with iron, &c. used as a weapon, a club, a mace. 3 A necklace. 4 Any creeping plant. 5 Liquorice. 6 A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 7 A string, a thread, especially as strung with pearls, &c. 8 A thread in general. m. (-ष्टिः) 1 A flag-staff. 2 The arm and forearm. E. यक्ष to worship, aff. क्तिन्, and the क of the compound final rejected.
यष्टिक: यष्टिक m. (-कः) A bird, the lapwing. f. (-का) 1 A necklace, especially of but one string. 2 A pond, a pool. 3 Liquorice. 4 A club, a staff, a bludgeon. E. कन् added to the preceding.
यष्टिग्रह: यष्टिग्रह m. (-हः) A club-bearer, one carrying a staff or stick. E. यष्टि a stick, and ग्रह to take, aff. अच्.
यष्टिमधु: यष्टिमधु n. (-धु) Liquorice, or the root of the Abrus precatorius, which is used for it. E. यष्टि a stick, and मधु honey; also with कन् added, fem. form यष्टिमधुका, and with the final of the first word long. यष्टीमधु.
यष्टृ: यष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) A sacrificer, one who employs priests for a sacrifice. E. यज to worship, aff. तृच्, and ज changed to ष.
यस: यस(इर उ) इर् यसु r. 1st and 4th cls. (यसति यस्यति) To endeavour, to persevere, to make strenuous and persevering exertion. With आङ् prefixed, To labour. With निर्, To exude.
यस्य: यस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 To be done with energy or perseverance. 2 To be killed or put to death. E. यस to strive यत् aff.
यस्यत्व: यस्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Death, being killed. 2 Effort, energy. E. त्व added to the last.
यह्व: यह्व m. (-ह्वः) A sacrificer, an institutor of sacrifices. E. या to go, वन् Uṇādi aff., and हुक् augment, form irr.
या: या r. 2nd cl. (याति) 1 To go, to go to. 2 To obtain, to get. With अनु prefixed, To follow. With अभि, To approach, to reach. With आङ्, To come, to arrive. With उप, To give way, to yield. With निर्, 1 To go out or forth. 2 To go readily or quickly. With प्र, To go to. With प्रति, To go to or towards. With प्रति and उत्, To meet, to advance to. With सम and अभि, To approach. With सम and आङ्, To arrive.
याग: याग m. (-गः) A sacrifice, any ceremony in which offerings and oblations are presented. E. यज to worship, aff. घञ्.
याच: याच (दु, ऋ) दुयाहृ r. 1st cl. (याचति-ते) 1 To ask or beg, to solicit, to request. 2 To offer, to tender.
याचक: याचक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Beggar, mendicant, asking, one who asks or solicits. E. याच to ask, aff. ण्वुल्.
याचनक: याचनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Beggar, mendicant. E. याचन an asker, and कन् added.
याचना: याचना f. (-ना) Asking, begging. E. याच to ask, aff. युच्.
याचमान: याचमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Asking, soliciting. E. याच to ask, शानच् aff.
याचनीय: याचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be asked, begged, &c. E. याच to ask, अनीयर् aff.
याचित: याचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Asked, begged, solicited. E. याच to ask, aff. क्त.
याचितक: याचितक n. (-कं) A thing borrowed for use. E. याचित asked, and कन् added; what is got by solicitation.
याच्य: याच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) To be asked, begged, &c. E. याच to ask, ण्य aff.
याच्यमान: याच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being asked or solicited. E. याच to ask, pass. v., शानच् aff.
याच्ञा: याच्ञा f. (-च्ञा) Asking, begging. E. याच to ask, नङ् aff.
याज: याज m. (-जः) Boiled rice, or generally, food. E. यज to present, aff. घञ्
याजक: याजक m. (-कः) 1 An officiating priest, a Brahman who conducts any part of a sacrifice. 2 A royal elephant. 3 A furious elephant. E. यज to worship, ण्वुल् aff.
याजन: याजन n. (-नं) Conducting a sacrifice or causing its performance. E. यज to worship, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
याजि: याजि m. (-जिः) A sacrificer, an institutor of sacrificial ceremonies. E. यज to sacrifice, Uṇādi aff. इञ्.
याजिन्: याजिन् m. (-जी) Sacrificing, one who officiates at a sacrifice. E. यज to sacrifice, घिनुण् aff.
याज्य: याज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) To be offered or sacrificed. m. (-ज्यः) A sacrificer, the person for whom it is performed. n. (-ज्यं) Property or presents derived from officiating at sacrifices. E. यज to worship, ण्य aff.
याजुष: याजुष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Belonging to or relating to the Yajur Veda. E. यजुर or यजुस् the Veda, and अण् aff.
याज्ञदत्ति: याज्ञदत्ति m. (-त्तिः) KUVERA. E. यज्ञदत्त a proper name, and इञ् aff. of descent.
याज्ञवल्क्य: याज्ञवल्क्य m. (-ल्क्यः) A celebrated saint and legislator; the supposed author of a celebrated code of laws, and the first reputed teacher of the white portion of the Yajur Veda revealed to him by the sun. E. यज्ञवल्क the father of the saint, and ष्यञ् aff.
याज्ञसेनी: याज्ञसेनी f. (-नी) A name of DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the Pāṇḍus. E. यज्ञसेन the father of the princess, and अण् patronymic aff., ङीष् fem. aff.
याज्ञिक: याज्ञिक m. (-कः) 1 A sacrificer, an institutor of a sacrifice. 2 An officiating priest at a sacrificial ceremony. 3 Kuśa or sacrificial grass. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and ठक् aff.
याज्ञिक्य: याज्ञिक्य n. (-क्यं) Sacrifice, sacrificial ceremonies. E. याज्ञिक a sacrificer, and यञ् aff.
याज्ञिय: याज्ञिय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Fit for sacrifice. E. यज्ञिय, and अण added.
यात्: यात् ind. An interjection. 1 of pleasure; 2 alarm; 3 restlessness.
यात् m. (-यान्-यान्ती-यात्) Going. E. या to go, शतृ aff.
यात: यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone, went. 2 Obtained, got. n. (-तं) Driving or guiding an elephant with a goad. E. यत to endeavour, or या to go, aff. क्त.
यातना: यातना f. (-ना) 1 Pain, agony, sharp or acute pain. 2 Pain or punishment inflicted by YAMA or his ministers, the pains of hell. E. यत to inflict pain, aff. युच्.
यातयाम: यातयाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Old. 2 Used, impaired. 3 Rejected, abandoned. 4 Raw, half ripe or dressed. E. यात gone or got, याम forbearance, relinquishment.
यातव्य: यातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be gone. 2 To be gone against, to be attacked or invaded. E. या to go, तव्य aff.
यातु: यातु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) A goer, one who goes or moves. m. (-तुः) A demon, a goblin, an imp or evil spirit. m. (-तुः) 1 Time. 2 A traveller, a wayfarer. E. या to go, तु Uṇādi aff.
यातुधान: यातुधान m. (-नः) A goblin, an evil spirit. E. यातु the same, घा to have, aff. ल्युट्.
यातृ: यातृ m. (-ता) 1 A charioteer, a driver. 2 A husband's brother's wife. E. यत to endeavour assiduously, Uṇādi aff. ऋत्, and the radical vowel made long.
यात्य: यात्य m. (-त्यः) An infernal or condemned spirit. E. यत to endeavour, causal form, aff. यत्, to be made to toil.
यात्रा: यात्रा f. (-त्रा) 1 Going, moving, proceeding, marching, travelling. 2 Passing away time. 3 Practice, usage, custom. 4 A holy festival, but especially the procession of idols, &c. which usually forms part of the ceremonies on such an occasion. 5 An expedient, a means. 6 The march of an assailing force. 7 Going to pilgrimage. 8 A sort of dramatic entertainment. E. या to go, Uṇādi aff. त्रन्.
यात्राकरण: यात्राकरण n. (-णं) Setting forth on a journey, a march, &c. E. यात्रा, and करण making.
यात्राप्रसङ्ग: यात्राप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Performing a pilgrimage. E. यात्रा, and प्रसङ्ग engaging in.
यात्रिक: यात्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to a march, &c. 2 Customary, usual. m. (-कः) 1 A pilgrim. 2 A traveller. n. (-कं) Provision, supplies, conveyance, &c. for a march. E. यात्रा, and ठक् aff.
यात्रोत्सव: यात्रोत्सव m. (-वः) A public festival. E. यात्रा procession, and उत्सव festival.
याथातथ्य: याथातथ्य n. (-थ्यं) Rectitude, truth, propriety. E. यथातथा, and ष्यञ् aff.
याथार्थिक: याथार्थिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Just, true, right. E. यथार्थ, and ठञ् aff.
याथार्थ्य: याथार्थ्य n. (-र्थ्यं) Application, use, accomplishment, attainment of an object. E. यथाथ, and ष्यञ् aff.
यादईश: यादईश m. (-शः) The ocean. E. यादस् an aquatic animal, and ईश lord.
यादःपति: यादःपति m. (-तिः) 1 The ocean. 2 VARUṆA, regent of water. E. यादस् a fish, &c., and पति lord.
यादव: यादव m. (-वः) 1 KṚṢṆA, as descended from the family of Yadu. 2 A Yādava, or descendant of Yadu. f. (-वी) A name of DURGĀ. n. (-वं) Stock of cattle. E. यदु a proper name, and अण् aff. of descent, &c.
यादस्: यादस् n. (-दः) Any aquatic or amphibious animal. E. या to go, (with speed,) असुन् aff., and दुक् augment.
यादसांनाथ: यादसांनाथ m. (-थः) VARUṆA, the deity of water. E. यादस् an aquatic animal, in the sixth case plural, and नाथ lord.
यादसाम्पति: यादसाम्पति m. (-तिः) VARUṆA, the ocean. E. यादसाम्, and पति lord: see the last.
यादृच्छिक: यादृच्छिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Independant, following one's own will. m. (-कः) A ministering priest who does as he pleases. E. यदृच्छा, and ठञ् aff.
यादृश्: यादृश् mfn. (-दृक) As like, how like, which like. E. यट् what, दृश to see, क्विन् aff., form irr.; also with खञ् aff. यादृश; mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) and with क्स added यादृक्ष (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं).
यादोनिवासस्: यादोनिवासस् n. (-सः) Water. E. यादम् an aquatic animal, and निवासस् abode.
यान: यान n. (-नं) 1 Any vehicle or form of conveyance, as a carriage, a litter, a horse, an elephant, &c. 2 Going, marching, proceeding. 3 Invading, marching against an enemy. E. या to go, aff. ल्युट्.
यानपात्र: यानपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel, a ship, a boat. E. यान going, (by water,) and पात्र a cup or vessel; also with कन् added यानपात्रक; n. (-कं.)
यानमुख: यानमुख n. (-खं) The forepart of a carriage, the pole or part where the yoke is fixed. E. यान a vehicle, and मुख face or front.
यानस्वामिन्: यानस्वामिन् m. (-मी) The owner of a vehicle. E. यान, and स्वामिन master.
यापन: यापन n. (-नं) 1 Spending or passing away time. 2 Abiding staying, being. 3 Rejection, ejection, expelling, expulsion. 4 Allaying, alleviating, (as pain or sickness.) E. या to go, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
यापनीय: यापनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be passed or spent as time. 2 To be allayed or relieved though not cured, (disease or a sick person.) E. या to go, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
याप्ता: याप्ता f. (-प्ता) Twisted or matted hair. E. या to go, in the causal form, aff. क्त.
याप्य: याप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) 1 Low, vile, contemptible. 2 To be passed or spent, (as time, &c.) 3 (In medicine,) To be alleviated or relieved though not cured, (disease.) E. या to go, causal form, aff. यत्.
याप्ययान: याप्ययान n. (-नं) A litter, a palanquin. E. याप्य vile, and यान carriage.
याम: याम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Relating to YAMA, done by him, ordered by him, &c. (-मः) 1 The eighth part of a day, a watch of three hours. 2 Forbearance. 3 Cessation, term. E. या to go, (through the day,) मन् Uṇādi aff., or यम to restrain, aff. घञ् or यम, and अण् aff.
यामघोष: यामघोष m. (-षः) A cock. f. (-षा) A clock, a metal plate on which the hours are struck, or a drum used for a similar purpose. E. याम a watch, and घोष sound.
यामनाली: यामनाली f. (-ली) A metal plate on which the hours are struck, or a drum used for that purpose. E. याम a watch, and नाली the same instrument.
यामनेमि: यामनेमि m. (-मिः) A name of INDRA.
यामल: यामल n. (-लं) A pair, a couple, a brace. E. यमल the same, and अण् pleonastic aff.
यामवती: यामवती f. (-ती) Night. E. याम a watch, and मतुप् aff.
यामातृ: यामातृ m. (-ता) A daughter's husband. E. य substituted for ज; see जामातृ.
यामि: यामि f. (-मिः-मी) 1 A sister. 2 A virtuous woman. 3 Night. 4 The south. 5 A daughter, or daughter-in-law, newly married. E. या to go, मि aff., or य substituted for ज, see जामि, or यम YAMA, and अण् aff. of reference.
यामिका: यामिका f. (-का) Night. E. याम a watch, कन् aff., fem. form.
यामिनी: यामिनी f. (-नी) Night. E. याम a watch, इनि aff.
यामिनीपति: यामिनीपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. यामिनी night, and पति master.
यामीर: यामीर m. (-रः) The moon. f. (-रा) Night. E. यामी night, रा to have or be, aff. क.
यामुन: यामुन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Relating to the Yamunā river. n. (-नं) Antimony, or rather the sulphuret of antimony, generally used as an application to darken the eyelashes, and strengthen the eyes. E. यमुना the Jumna river, and अण् aff.
यामेय: यामेय m. (-यः) A sister's son. E. यामि a sister, and ढक् aff.
याम्य: याम्य m. (-म्यः) 1 Sandal. 2 The saint AGASTYA. f. (-म्या) 1 The south. 2 The lunar asterism, Bharaṇī. 3 Night. E. यम YAMA, ण्यत् aff.; being sacred to or governed by that deity, &c.
याम्यायन: याम्यायन n. (-नं) The sun's course, south of the line. E. याम्य the south, अयन going.
यायजूक: यायजूक m. (-कः) The performer of frequent sacrifices. E. यज to sacrifice, aff. ऊक, the root repeated, and the first vowel made long.
यायावर: यायावर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Going repeatedly. 2 Wandering, vagrant. m. (-रः) 1 A horse fit for the Aśvamedha sacrifice. 2 The saint JARATKĀRU. 3 A Brahman who has preserved his household fire. 4 A vagrant mendicant. E. या to go, in the reiterative form, and वरच् aff.
यायिन्: यायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Going, who or what goes. E. या to go, णिनि aff., युक् inserted.
याव: याव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Relating to barley. m. (-वः) Lac, the red animal dye. E. यु to join, aff. अण्; the nest yielding a sort of resinous substance used as sealing-wax: or यव barley, to which the grains of the dye are compared, and अण् aff.
यावक: यावक m. (-कः) 1 Half-ripe barley. 2 Awnless barley. 3 Forced rice. 4 A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus.) 5 A kind of pulse, (Dolichos biflorus.) 6 A kind of pulse said to be peculiar to Kashmir. 7 Lac. E. यु to mix, aff. वुन्, and अण् added, or याव as above, pleonastic aff. कन्.
यावच्छक्य: यावच्छक्य adv. (-क्यं) To the utmost of one's power. E. यावत्, and शक्य able.
यावज्जीव: यावज्जीव n. adv. (-वं) For life, as long as life. E. यावत् until, जीव life.
यावत्: यावत् mfn. (-यावान्, यावती यावत्) As much, how much, such. ind. 1 As much as. 2 As many as. 3 As long as. 4 As far as, unto, until; the correlative of तावत्. 5 When, (i. e. as much, applied to time.) E. यत् what or which, डवतुप् aff., and आ substituted for the pronominal final.
यावतिथ: यावतिथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) That which is as far as, or as much as, &c. the ordinal of the particle यावत्. E. यावत् as much as, &c., and तिथक aff.
यावत्तावत्: यावत्तावत् ind. 1 As much as, quantum-tantum. 2 (In algebra,) The relation of the unknown number and its co-efficient. E. यावत्, and तावत् so much.
यावन: यावन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Belonging or relating to a Yavana, Ionian, Mohammedan, &c. m. (-नः) Incense. E. यवन the country of the Yavanas, and अण् aff.
यावनाल: यावनाल m. (-लः) A kind of grain, (Andropogon or Holcus bicolor.) E. यवनाल, and अण् pleonasm.
यावशूक: यावशूक m. (-कः) Nitre, saltpetre. E. यव barley, शूक the spike, and अण् aff.
यावस: यावस m. (-सः) A quantity or heap of grass. E. यु to mix, Uṇādi aff. असच् with the effect of णित्, which makes the vowel long.
याव्य: याव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be mixed or joined, miscible. E. यु to join or mix, aff. ण्यत्.
याशोधरेय: याशोधरेय m. (-यः) The son of ŚĀKYAMUNI, the probable founder of the Bauddha sect.
याष्टीक: याष्टीक m. (-कः) A warrior armed with a club. E. यष्टि a stick, a club, ठक् aff., and both vowels made long.
यास: यास m. (-सः) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) f. (-सा) A sort of bird, the Sārikā. E. यस to endeavour, aff. घञ्.
यास्यत्: यास्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्) Going, who or what will be going. E. या to go, शतृ aff., with the future tense.
यियक्षमान: यियक्षमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Purposing or wishing to worship. E. यज to worship, desid. v., शानच् aff.
यियक्षु: यियक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Desirous of sacrificing. E. यज to worship, desid. v., उ aff.
यियविषा: यियविषा f. (-षा) Wish to mix, blend, &c. E. यु to mix, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् aff.
यियविषु: यियविषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to mix or blend. E. यु to mix, desid. v., उ aff.
यु: यु r. 2nd cl. (यौति) 1 To mix, to join, to blend. 2 To separate or not mix. r. 10th cl. (यावयति) To censure, to blame, to disrespect, to despise. (ञ) युञ् r. 9th cl. (युनाति युनीते) To bind, to tie.
युक्त: युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Joined, combined, united, identified. 2 Right, fit, proper. 3 Proved, concluded by inference or argument. 4 Moderate, limited. 5 Possessing, endowed with, as virtues, qualities, &c. 6 Intent on, attached to, as a study or pursuit. 7 Employed or engaged in business, &c. 8 Occupied in performance of the religious exercise called Yoga. m. (-क्तः) The sage who has acquired the command of his feelings and passions, and who performs the customary devotional offices without any regard to their result. n. (-क्तं) A measure of four cubits. f. (-क्ता) A plant, commonly Elāni. E. युज to join or mix, aff. क्त.
युक्तरसा: युक्तरसा f. (-सा) A plant, commonly Elāni, (Mimosa octandra.) E. युक्त mixed, joined, रस juice.
युक्तायस्: युक्तायस् n. (-यः) A sort of wooden spade or shovel. E. युक्त bound, joined, and अयस् iron.
युक्ति: युक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Union, connection, joining. 2 Propriety, fitness. 3 Usage, custom, traditionary and unwritten law. 4 Inference, deduction from circumstance or argument, the reason of a thing or argument. 5 Insertion of circumstanced in written  evidence, specification in writing of place, time, &c. considered as one of the means of verifying such evidence. 6 A figure of rhetoric, emblematic or mystical expression of purpose, so as to conceal it from all but its immediate object. 7 Supplying an ellipsis. 8 Connection of dramatic events, the production of one incident by another. E. युज to join, &c., aff. क्तिन्.
युग: युग(इ)युगि r. 1st cl (युंगति) To except, to abandon.

युग n. (-गं) 1 A pair, a couple, a brace. 2 An age, as the Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara, and Kali. 3 A lustre, or period of five years. m. (-गः) 1 A yoke. 2 A measure of four cubits. 3 A drug, commonly Ṛddhi. E. युज to join, aff. अच्, and the final changed.
युगकीलक: युगकीलक m. (-कः) The pin of a yoke. E. युग a yoke, and कील a pin or bolt, कन् added.
युगक्षय: युगक्षय m. (-यः) Destruction of the world. E. युग, and क्षय destruction.
युगन्धर: युगन्धर mn. (-रः-रं) 1 The pole of a carriage, or wood to which the yoke is fixed. 2 The name of a mountain. E. युग a yoke, धृ to hold or support, खच् aff.
युगपत्: युगपत् ind. 1 At one time, at once. 2 Together, conjointly. E. यु to join, गपतक् aff.
युगपत्र: युगपत्र m. (-त्रः) Mountain ebony: see the next.
युगपत्रक: युगपत्रक m. (-कः) Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.) f. (-त्रिका) The Sisu tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.) E. युग a pair, and पत्र a leaf, aff. कन्, double-leaved.
युगपार्श्वग: युगपार्श्वग m. (-गः) A young ox in training. E. युग a yoke, पार्श्व a side, and ग who goes, or with कन् aff. युगपार्श्वंक m. (-कः.)
युगल: युगल n. (-लं) A pair, a brace, a couple. E. युग a pair, लच् aff.
युगांशक: युगांशक m. (-कः) A year. E. युग an age, and अंशक a part.
युगान्त: युगान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A destruction of the universe. 2 The end of an age. E. युग an age, either generally or individually, and अन्त end.
युगान्तबन्धु: युगान्तबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A real friend, a friend in need. E. युगान्त, and बन्धु a friend.
युग्म: युग्म n. (-ग्मं) 1 A pair, a couple, a brace. 2 Mixing, uniting. 3 A couple of verses. E. युज to join, Uṇādi aff. मक्, and the final changed.
युग्मक: युग्मक n. (-कं) 1 A couple. 2 A couple of verses connected by the construction of the sentence, the sense being completed only by the two together. E. कन् added to the last.
युग्मपत्र: युग्मपत्र m. (-त्रः) Mountain ebony. E. युग्म a couple, and पत्र a leaf, double-leaved.
युग्मपत्रिका: युग्मपत्रिका f. (-का) A timber tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.) E. युग्म a pair, and पत्र a leaf, कन् added, fem. form.
युग्मफलोत्तम: युग्मफलोत्तम m. (-मः) A plant, (Asclepias rosea.) E. युग्म double, फल fruit, and उत्तम best.
युग्य: युग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Fit or proper to be yoked or harnessed. n. (-ग्यं) Any vehicle or conveyance. m. (-ग्यः) An animal yoked. E. युज to join, aff. यत् or क्यप्.
युच्छ: युच्छ r. 1st cl. (युच्छति) To be inattentive or negligent, to err or mistake.
युज: युज(औ)युजौ r. 4th cl. (युज्यते) To confine the thoughts, to keep the mind fixed in abstract meditation. r. 1st and 10th cls. (योजति योजयति) To bind, to tie, to connect. (योजयत) To blame. (औ, इर,) औ युजिर r. 7th cl. (युनक्ति युंक्ते) To join, to mix, to unite, &c. With अनु prefixed, 1 To ask, to inquire. 2 To reprove. With अभि, 1 To utter, to speak. 2 To accuse. With उत्, To make effort. With उप, 1 To seize, to take, to lay hold of. 2 To eat. With नि, 1 To order, to appoint. 2 To join. With प्र, 1 To be fit or due. 2 To attach or apply to. 3 To lend money. 4 To make effort. 5 To combine or connect. With वि, 1 To separate, to sunder. 2 To send. With वि and नि, 1 To appoint or employ. 2 To expend. 3 To send. 4 To involve in or force upon. With वि and प्र, to separate, to part, to divide. With सम्, To unite, to combine. With सम् and आङ्, To think profoundly.
युज्: युज् n. (-युक्) A pair, a couple. m. (-युक् युग्) A sage, one who devotes his time to abstract contemplation. ind. (-जौ) The twin sons of AŚVINĪ, and physicians of Svarga. m. (-युङ्) A joiner, one who joins or unites. f. (-युक्) A measure of three hundred poles. E. युज to join, to meditate, &c., aff. क्विन्; also युजिर् the same, with the same aff., when न is inserted after the vowel, before the first five affixes in the masc. and fem. genders.
युञ्जत्: युञ्जत् mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत्) 1 Uniting, joining. 2 Uniting spiritually, practising devotion. E. युज to join, &c., शतृ aff.
युञ्जान: युञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Uniting, combining, joining with. m. (-नः) 1 A charioteer. 2 A Brahman engaged in the religious exercise called Yoga. E. युज to join, &c., aff. शानच्, and नुम् inserted.
युत: युत r. 1st cl. (ऋ) युतृ (योतते) To shine.
युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Joined, combined, connected, identified. 2 Attached to, engaged in or by. 3 Endowed with, possessed of. n. (-तं) A measure of four cubits. E. यु to join, &c., aff. क्त.
युतक: युतक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Joined, combined. n. (-कं) 1 Doubt, uncertainty. 2 A pair, a brace. 3 Nuptial presents. 4 The end of a cloth worn by women. 5 A garment worn by women; it is applied, it is said, both to the petticoat, and the upper wrapper or cloth. 6 The ends of a cloth. 7 The edge of a winnowing basket. 8 Asylum. 9 Forbearance, cessation. 10 Alliance, acquaintance, forming an alliance or friendship. E. युत joined, &c., कन् added.
युति: युति f. (-तिः) 1 Joining, uniting. 2 (In arithmetic,) Addition. E. यु to join, क्तिन् aff.
युद्ध: युद्ध n. (-द्धं) War, battle, contest, conflict. E. युध to fight, aff. क्त.
युद्घरङ्ग: युद्घरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A name of the deity KĀRTTIKEYA. E. युद्ध war, and रङ्ग delight.
युद्घसार: युद्घसार m. (-रः) A horse. E. युद्ध war, सृ to go, aff. घञ्.
युद्घोन्मत्त: युद्घोन्मत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Fierce or frantic in battle. E. युद्ध, and उन्मत्त frantic.
युध: युध(औ) r. 4th cl. औयुध (युध्यते) To fight, to contend in battle, to slay.
युध्: युध् f. (-युत् or -युट्) War, battle. E. युध to fight, aff. क्विप्.
युधान: युधान m. (-नः) A man of the second or military order, a soldier, a warrior. E. युध to fight, Uṇādi aff. आनच्, and the radical vowel unchanged.
युधिष्ठिर: युधिष्ठिर m. (-रः) The elder of the five Pāṇḍava princes, and leader in the great war, between them and the Kurus, in the beginning of the fourth age; the nominal son of PĀṆḌU, whom he succeeded in the sovereignty of India, but according to the legend, begotten on Kunti by the deity YAMA. E. युधि in war or battle, and ष्ठिर for स्थिर firm; it is also sometimes read युद्घस्थिर.
युध्म: युध्म m. (-ध्मः) 1 War, battle. 2 A bow. 3 An arrow. 4 A warrior, a combatant. E. युध to fight, मक् Uṇādi aff.
युध्यमान: युध्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fighting, warring. E. युध to fight, शानच् aff.
युप: युप r. 4th cl. (ईर्) युपीर (युप्यति) To confuse, to perplex.
युयुक्खुर: युयुक्खुर m. (-रः) A hyena. E. युयुक् joined, खुर a hoof.
युयुक्षमान: युयुक्षमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Wishing to join or unite. 2 Devout, wishing to effect spiritual union with the divine essence. E. युज to be devout or to join, desid. v., शानच् aff.
युयुत्सा: युयुत्सा f. (-त्सा) Wish or purpose to fight, enmity, pugnacity. E. युध to fight, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
युयुत्सारहित: युयुत्सारहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cowardly, having no intention to fight. E. युयुत्सा, and रहित void of.
युयुत्सु: युयुत्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing or ready to make war or fight, pugnacious, hostile, ambitious. m. (-त्सुः) A combatant. E. युध to make war, desid. v., उ aff.
युयुधान: युयुधान m. (-नः) 1 A proper name, one of the chiefs of the Pāṇḍus. 2 A warrior. E. युध to fight, in the reduplicate form, शानच् aff.
युवखलति: युवखलति mfn. (-तिः-तिः or -ती-ति) Bald in youth. E. युवन्, and खलति bald; also युवाखलति, and fem. युवतिःखलति.
युवगण्ड: युवगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Eruptions on the face peculiar to youth. E. युव a young person, from युवन्, and गण्ड what affects the cheek.
युवजरत्: युवजरत् mfn. (-रन्-रती-रत्) Being old as it were in youth, oldfashioned, or prematurely infirm. E. युवन्, and जरत् old; also युवाजरत्, and in the fem. युवतिःजरती.
युवजानि: युवजानि m. (-निः) Having a young wife. E. युव, and जानि wife.
युवन्: युवन् mfn. (-युवा-युवति or -ती or यूनी-युव) 1 Young. 2 Best, excellent. 3 Endowed with native or natural strength. m. (-वा) A young man or one of the virile age, or from sixteen to seventy. f. (-तिः-ती or यूनी) A young woman, one from sixteen to thirty. (-तिः) Turmeric. E. यु to mix or associate, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, the fem. form takes ति, and optionally adds ङीष् in one form, with which affix the semivowel व is changed to its congener उ, and the two short vowels coalesce into one long one, making यूनी.
युवनाश्वज: युवनाश्वज m. (-जः) A name of MĀNDHĀTĀ, an early sovereign of the Solar dynasty. E. युवनाश्व his father, who appears as the eighth monarch of the Solar line, and ज born.
युवपलित: युवपलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Grey-haired in youth. E. युवन्, and पलित gray-haired; also युवापलित, and fem. युवतिःपलिता.
युवराज: युवराज m. (-जः) 1 A young prince, especially the heir apparent, associated to the throne. 2 One of the Jaina pontiffs. E. युव young, and राजन् a prince, टच् aff.
युवराज्य: युवराज्य n. (-ज्यं) The dignity of heir apparent and associate in the throne. E. युवराज, and यत् aff.
युष्मद्: युष्मद् 2nd personal pronoun. mf. (-त्वं) Thou. E. युष Sautra root, to serve, to worship, Uṇādi aff. मदिक्.
युष्मद्वाच्य: युष्मद्वाच्य n. (-च्यं) (In grammar,) The second person. E. युष्मट्, and वाच्य to be said.
यू: यू f. (-यूः) The water in which pulse, &c. has been boiled, pease-soup, &c. E. यु to mix, aff. क्विप्, and vowel made long.
यूक: यूक mf. (-कः-का) A louse. E. यु to mix, (with the hair,) Uṇādi aff. कन्, and the vowel made long.
यूति: यूति f. (-तिः) Joining, mixing. E. यु to join, aff. क्तिच्, and the vowel made long.
यूथ: यूथ m. (-थं) A multitude of birds or beasts, a herd, a flock. f. (-थी) A kind of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.) E. यु to mix, थक् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long.
यूथनाथ: यूथनाथ m. (-थः) A large elephant, the leader of a wild herd. E. यूथ a multitude, (of elephants,) and नाथ lord.
यूथप: यूथप m. (-पः) The leader of a wild herd of elephants. E. यूथ a herd, and प who protects: see the last.
यूथभ्रष्ट: यूथभ्रष्ट m. (-ष्टः) An elephant turned out or driven from a herd. E. यूथ the herd, and भ्रष्ट expelled.
यूथशस्: यूथशस् adv. Gregariously, in flocks. E. यूथ, and शसि aff.
यूथिका: यूथिका f. (-का) 1 A sort of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.) 2 Globe amaranth. E. यूथी the jasmine, कन् aff., fem. form.
यूनि: यूनि f. (-निः) Joining, union, junction. E. यु to join or mix, aff. क्तिन्, न substituted for the final, and the vowel made long.
यूप: यूप mn. (-पः-पं) 1 A sacrificial post, a pillar usually made of bambus, or the wood of the Khadira, to which the victim at a sacrifice is bound. 2 A trophy, a column erected in honour of a victory. E. यु to bind (the victim), प Uṇādi aff.
यूपकटक: यूपकटक m. (-कः) A wooden ring on the top of a sacrificial post, or according to some authorities, an iron ring at its base. E. यूप the post, and कटक् a ring, &c.
यूपकर्ण: यूपकर्ण m. (-र्णः) A part of a sacrificial post sprinkled with ghee. E. यूप the post, and कर्ण the ear.
यूपद्रु: यूपद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.) E. यूप a sacrificial post, and द्रु a tree; the wood of this tree being especially fit for the sacrificial post; also यूपद्रुम m. (-मः.)
यूपलक्ष्य: यूपलक्ष्य m. (-क्ष्यः) A bird. E. यूप a sacrificial post, put for any post, and लक्ष्य an aim; a sort of net being made about a post, on which birds may alight.
यूपाग्र: यूपाग्र m. (-ग्रः) The top of the sacrificial post. E. यूप as above, and अग्र top.
यूपोच्छ्रय: यूपोच्छ्रय m. (-यः) The ceremony of erecting the sacrificial post. E. यूप a sacrificial post, and उच्छ्रय elevation.
यूष: यूष r. 1st cl. (यूषति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.
यूष mn. (-षः-षं) Pease soup, pease porridge, the water in which pulse of various kinds has been boiled. m. (-षः) The mulberry tree, (Morus Indica); also पूष. E. यूष to hurt, क aff.
येष: येष(ऋ)येषृ r. 1st cl. (येषते) To resolve, to endeavour diligently, to persevere.
योक्तव्य: योक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be joined or united. 2 To be performed, (as devotion.) 3 To be united spiritually. E. युज to join, तव्य aff.
योक्त्र: योक्त्र n. (-क्त्रं) The tie of the yoke of a plough. E. युज to join, Uṇādi aff. त्रन्.
योग: योग m. (-गः) 1 Junction, joining, union. 2 Combination, association, meeting, conflux. 3 Religious and abstract meditation. 4 Keeping the body in a fixed posture. 5 Devotion, spiritual worship of GOD, or union with the Supreme Being by means of abstract contemplation; this does not necessarily imply an abandonment of the world or relinquishment of the usual observances of religion, but it involves internal indifference to objects of pleasure and pain, and utter disregard of the consequences or fruit of ceremonial rites. 6 The particular practice of the preceding sort of devotion, or the exercise of that abstraction by which union with GOD is supposed to be obtained; in the Gītā it is described as sitting on Kuśa grass, with the body firm, the eyes fixed on the tip of the nose, and the mind intent on the Deity; in the Tantras a fanciful operation is prescribed, by which the vital spirit seated in the lower part of the body, and the etherial spirit placed in the head, are supposed to be brought into combination in the brain, when the devotee becomes united with BRAHMA. 7 The system of philosophy which treats of the union of the soul with BRAHMA or GOD; it is the same as the Pātañjali doctrine, and constitutes one of the six Darśanas or philosophical schools of the Hindus. 8 Magic, or the acquisition of supernatural powers by the mystical and magical worship of ŚIVA and DURGĀ especially. 9 Consequence, result, the main end or object of any thing or act. 10 Connexion of one thing with another, as of cause with effect, predicate with subject, quality with substance, &c. 11 Acquisition of something not possessed before, accession of property or wealth; in grammar this application is assigned to any unusual construction of words or compounds, unauthorised by rule, but sanctioned by the authority that employs them. 12 A rule, an aphorism. 13 Propriety, fitness. 14 Side, part, cause or argument to be maintained or defended. 15 Thing, substance. 16 Wealth. 17 A drug, a medicament, especially a compound of various ingredients. 18 Fraud, trick. 19 A logician. 20 A spy, an informer. 21 A violator of truth or confidence. 22 A conveyance, a carriage, a boat, &c. 23 A means, an expedient. 24 Armour. 25 Putting on armour. 26 Lucky conjuncture. 27 (In arithmetic,) Addition. 28 (In astronomy,) The leading or principal star of a lunar mansion. 29 The twenty-seventh part of 360° of a great circle measured on the plane of the ecliptic, and used in calculating the longitudes of the sun and moon; each Yogas has a distinct name; astrologers also enumerate twenty-eight Yogas differently named from the foregoing, and corresponding with the twenty-eight Nakṣatras, or the divisions of the moon's path, but varying according to the day of the week. 30 A period, or the time during which the sum of the motions of the sun and moon amount to one Nakṣatra, the mean duration of which is 23hs. 47' 44". E. युज to join literally or figuratively, as with GOD, aff. घञ्.
योगक्षेम: योगक्षेम n. (-मः) 1 Charge of property, keeping of cattle, &c. for another. 2 Insurance or charge for secure conveyance of goods, and the profit on their sale. 3 Profit, gain, keeping the old and making fresh gains. 4 Such articles as are not divisible amongst coheirs. 5 Welfare, well-being. 6 National prosperity the good government of a state, or the means of maintaining it; as the Raja, minister, priest, &c. forming the administration. E. योग profit, and क्षेम safety or preservation; or योग association, and क्षेम patience.
योगक्षेमकर: योगक्षेमकर m. (-रः) A keeper, one who takes charge of property, &c. E. योग, and कर who makes.
योगचर: योगचर m. (-रः) A name of HANUMĀN. E. योग possession of superhuman powers, and चर going, possessing.
योगतस्: योगतस् ind. 1 Suitably, properly. 2 Seasonably, in due season. 3 Through devotion, magic, &c. 4 Conjointly. E. योग, and तसि aff.
योगदान: योगदान n. (-नं) 1 A fraudulent gift. 2 Communicating the Yoga doctrine. E. योग, and दान gift.
योगनाविक: योगनाविक m. (-कः) A sort of fish, (Silurus ascita.)
योगनिद्रा: योगनिद्रा f. (-द्रा) 1 The sleep of VIṢṆU during the deluge. 2 A goddess, a form of DURGĀ or VIṢṆU'S sleep personified. E. योग mystery, and निद्रा sleep.
योगपट्ट: योगपट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A cloth drawn round the lower extremities of the ascetic as he squats to perform religious abstraction. E. योग a religious exercise, and पट्ट cloth.
योगवाहिन्: योगवाहिन् m. (-ही) A menstruum or medium for mixing medicines. E. योग, and वाहिन् conveyer.
योगवाही: योगवाही f. (-ही) 1 Alkali. 2 Quicksilver. E. योग joining of metals, वाह effecting.
योगविक्रय: योगविक्रय m. (-यः) Fraudulent sale. E. योग, and विक्रय sale.
योगविद्: योगविद् m. (-वित्) 1 A follower of the Yoga doctrines. 2 A practiser of devotional exercises. 3 A magician. 4 A compounder of medicines. E. योग, and विद् who knows.
योगसेवा: योगसेवा f. (-वा) Practising religious abstraction. E. योग, and सेवा observance.
योगाधमन: योगाधमन n. (-नं) A fraudulent pledge. E. योग fraud, and आधमन a pledge.
योगारूढ: योगारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Engaged in devotional exercises. E. योग, and आरूढ mounted on.
योगासन: योगासन n. (-नं) A religious posture, the position in which the devotee sits to perform the religious exercise called Yoga. E. योग as above, and आसन seat or sitting.
योगिन्: योगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) 1 Who or what joins, or effects junction or connection, &c. 2 Possessed of superhuman powers. m. (-गी) 1 A devotee, an ascetic in general. 2 The religious or devout man, who performs worldly actions and ceremonies without regard to their results, and keeps his mind fixed upon BRAHMA or GOD alone. 3 The performer of the particular act of meditation called Yoga. 4 A magician, a conjuror, one supposed to have obtained supernatural powers. f. (-नी) A female fiend or sprite attendant on, and created by DURGA; in some places eight Yoginīs are enumerated by name. E. योग as above, इनि aff., or युज to join, aff. घिणुन्.
योगिनिद्रा: योगिनिद्रा f. (-द्रा) Light sleep, wakefulness. E. योगिन् a saint, and निद्रा sleep.
योगेश: योगेश m. (-शः) 1 The city of BRAHMĀ. 2 The saint and legislator YĀJÑAVALKYA. 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 Any principal Muni or  Yogi. E. यीग a Yogi or religious personage, &c., and ईश lord or chief.
योगेश्वर: योगेश्वर m. (-रः) 1 A principal sage or ascetic. 2 A magician, one who has superhuman faculties. 3 A deity, the object of devout contemplation. E. योग, and ईश्वर lord.
योगेष्ट: योगेष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Lead. E. योग affinity, (of metals or amalgamation,) इष्ट desired.
योग्य: योग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) 1 Clever, skilful. 2 Fit or proper for a Yoga, or for religious meditation. 3 Powerful, able. 4 Fit, proper, suitable. n. (-ग्यं) 1 A drug, commonly Ṛddhi. 2 A cake. 3 A vehicle or conveyance. 4 Sandal. m. (-ग्यः) A calculator of expedients. f. (-ग्या) 1 Military exercise. 2 Medical practice. E. युज to join or mix, aff. ण्यत्, or योग union, and यत् aff.
योग्यता: योग्यता f. (-ता) Fitness, suitableness, propriety. E. योग्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, योग्यत्वं.
योजन: योजन n. (-नं) 1 GOD, the SUPREME BEIṄG, the soul of the world. 2 A measure of distance equal to four Krośas, which at 8000 cubits or 4000 yards to the Krośa or Kos, will be exactly nine miles; other computations make the Yojana but about five miles, or even no more than four miles and a half. 2 Joining, union, junction. E. युज to join, aff. ल्युट्.
योजनगन्धा: योजनगन्धा f. (-न्धा) 1 Musk. 2 A name of SĪTĀ. 3 A name of SATYAVATĪ, the mother of the sage and poet VYĀSA. E. योजन a Yojana, and गन्ध smell; whose odour is perceptible miles off; also with कन् added, fem. form, योजनगन्धिका.
योजनपर्णी: योजनपर्णी f. (-र्णी) Bengal madder. E. योजन joining, and पर्ण leaf.
योजनवल्ली: योजनवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) E. योजन joining, and वल्ली pedicle.
योजनीय: योजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be joined. 2 To be added. E. युज to join, अनीयर् aff.
योजयितृ: योजयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Joining, combining, who or what unites. E. युज to join, causal v., शतृ aff.
योजित: योजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mixed, joined. E. युज to join, aff. क्त, more usually युक्त.
योतु: योतु m. (-तुः) 1 Measure in general. 2 Cleaning, purifying. 3 A cleanser, a purifier. E. यु to mix, or not to mix, and तुन् Uṇādi aff.
योत्र: योत्र n. (-त्रं) The tie that fastens the yoke of a plough to the neck of the ox. E. यु to join, ष्ट्रन् aff.
योत्स्यमान: योत्स्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) About to fight, ready to fight. E. युध to fight, desid. v., future tense, शतृ aff.
योद्धव्य: योद्धव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be fought, what must or ought to be fought. E. युध to fight, ण्यत् aff.
योद्धृ: योद्धृ m. (-द्धा) A warrior, a combatant. E. युध to fight, aff. तृच्.
योध: योध m. (-धः) A warrior, a soldier, a combatant. E. युध to fight, aff. अच्.
योधमुख्य: योधमुख्य m. (-ख्यः) A leader, a chief warrior. E. योध, and मुख्य chief.
योधयत्: योधयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Fighting, warring. E. युध to fight, शतृ aff.
योधवीर: योधवीर m. (-रः) A hero, a warrior. E. योध, and वीर a hero.
योधसंराव: योधसंराव m. (-वः) Mutual defiance, challenging or braving each other. E. योध a warrior, संराव cry or shout.
योधहर: योधहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Carrying soldiers fit for war, (horses.) E. योध, and हर what takes.
योधिन्: योधिन् m. (-धी) A warrior. E. युध to fight, घिनुण् aff.
योधेय: योधेय m. (-यः) A warrior. E. युद्घ war, and ढक् aff.
योनल: योनल m. (-लः) A sort of grain, (Andropogon or Holcus sorghum.) E. यव barley, and नल culm or stalk, the व of the first word changed to उ, and उ with the inherent vowel of य changed to ओ.
योनि: योनि mf. (-निः-निः or नी) 1 The vulva. 2 A mine. 3 Cause, origin. 4 Water. 5 Place or site of birth or production in general. E. यु to join or mix, Uṇādi aff. नि.
योनिदेवता: योनिदेवता f. (-ता) The 11th Nakṣatra or lunar asterism; also Pūrvaphalgunī. E. योनि the vulva, and दवता presiding deity.
योनिनासा: योनिनासा f. (-सा) The upper part of the vulva, or the union of the labiæ. E. योनि the womb, and नासा the nose.
योनिरञ्जन: योनिरञ्जन n. (-नं) The menstrual excretion. E. योनि pudendum, and रञ्जन colouring.
योनिलिङ्ग: योनिलिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The clitoris. E. योनि the pudendum, and लिङ्ग the penis.
योनिसंवृत्ति: योनिसंवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Contraction or closure of the vagina. E. योनि, and संवृत्ति contraction.
योनिसङ्कर: योनिसङ्कर m. (-रः) Fault or blemish of birth on the mother's side, as from inferiority of caste, &c. E. योनि, and सङ्कर mixture.
योन्यर्शस्: योन्यर्शस् n. (-र्शः) An affection of the vulva, Menorrhagia, or prolapsus uteri. E. योनि the vulva, and अर्शस् piles.
योषा: योषा f. (-षा) A woman. E. युष to serve, Sautra root, causal form, aff. अच् and टाप्.
योषित्: योषित् f. (-षित्) A woman in general. E. युष Sautra root, to serve, to worship, to hurt, इति Uṇādi aff.; also with टाप् added योषिता f. (-ता.)
योषित्कृत: योषित्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done by a woman, contracted by her, &c. E. योषित्, and कृत done.
यौक्तिक: यौक्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Connective, binding. 2 Inferrible, deducible. 3 Customary, usual. 4 Right, proper. m. (-कः) A minister or associate to one's pleasure or amusements. E. युक्ति union, association, aff. ठक्.
यौगक: यौगक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the religious practice, &c. called Yoga. E. योग as above, and ठञ् aff.
यौगिक: यौगिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Customary, usual, common. 2 Relating to the Yoga, &c. 3 Proper, regular, (as the sense of words, depending upon their derivation or construction.) E. योग, and ठञ् aff.
यौजनशतिक: यौजनशतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Proceeding or extending a hundred Yojanas. E. योजन a measure so named, शत a hundred, and ठञ् aff.
यौजनिक: यौजनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Extending or proceeding a Yojana. E. योजन a Yojana, and ठक् aff.
यौट: यौट(ऋ,)यौटृ r. 1st cl. (यौटति) To bind, to tie, to join or fasten; also read यौडृ.
यौतक: यौतक n. (-कं) A nuptial gift, presents made to a bride, at her marriage, by her father or friends; some consider it also implying a gift to the bridegroom. E. युतक the same, pleonastic aff. अण.
यौतव: यौतव n. (-व) Measure in general. E. योतु the same, अण् aff.; some authorities read यौवत.
यौधेय: यौधेय m. (-यः) A warrior. E. योधेय the same, and अण् pleonasm.
यौन: यौन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 Relating to the womb or place of origin, uterine. 2 Connected by female alliance, marriage, &c. E. योनि, and अण् aff.
यौवत: यौवत n. (-तं) 1 Measure in general. 2 An assemblage of young women. E. यु to mix, deriv. irr., or युवती a young woman, aff. अण्.
यौवन: यौवन n. (-नं) 1 Youth manhood. 2 An assemblage of young women. E. युवन young, अण् aff.
यौवनकण्टक: यौवनकण्टक m. (-कः) Pimples on the face, especially in young persons. E. यौवन youth, and कण्टक a thorn.
यौवनदर्प: यौवनदर्प m. (-र्पः) Pride of youth, rashness, conceit. E. यौवन, and दर्प pride.
यौवनदशा: यौवनदशा f. (-शा) The period of youth. E. यौवन, and दशा state.
यौवनपिडका: यौवनपिडका f. (-का) Blotches or pimples on the face in youth. E. यौवन, and पिडका a pimple.
यौवनलक्षण: यौवनलक्षण n. (-णं) 1 The breast, the bosom. 2 Beauty, handsomeness. E. यौवन youth, लक्षण mark or sign.
यौवनवत्: यौवनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Youthful. E. यौवन, and मतुप् aff.
यौवनाश्व: यौवनाश्व m. (-श्वः) A name of MĀNDHĀTĀ, one of the kings of the solar dynasty. E. युवनाश्च a proper name, and अण् patronymic aff.
यौष्माक: यौष्माक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Yours, belonging to you. E. युष्माक for युष्मट् you, and aff. अण्.
यौष्माकीन: यौष्माकीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Yours, thine. E. युष्माक for युष्मट् thou, and खञ् aff. र
